# Codebase knowledge builder (Ahmad Othman Ammar Adi)

Studies an unfamiliar repository and writes a cited, revision-specific knowledge document.

- Source: https://github.com/OthmanAdi/codebase-knowledge-builder
- SKILL.md: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OthmanAdi/codebase-knowledge-builder/main/skills/codebase-knowledge-builder/SKILL.md
- Author: Ahmad Othman Ammar Adi
- License: MIT
- Page: https://commandvault.ai/commands/codebase-knowledge-builder-ahmad-othman-ammar-adi-83cd0d53

Claude works in four phases: reconnaissance of the repo's shape, deep dives into requested topics, writing the knowledge artifact from a template, and validating it before delivery. Every claim is labeled observed, inferred or unknown, and observed claims cite file and line. By default it reads the target without running code, installing dependencies or changing git state, and it skips secret files such as .env.

**Try asking:**
- "Study this repo and write an onboarding guide for new engineers"
- "Trace how a request flows through the API layer and document it with citations"
- "Map the architecture of the payments service at the current commit"
